# UC Application Portal

> > Official application portal for the University of California system, providing account management and application support for prospective students.

This portal serves as the primary gateway for students applying to UC campuses. It handles user authentication, account recovery, and application management for undergraduate and transfer applicants across all University of California institutions.

## Key Topics

- University of California
- UC Application
- Password Reset
- Account Recovery
- User Authentication
- Email Verification
- Application Account Management
- Student Portal Access
- UC Admissions
- Applicant Support

## Account Support

- [Reset Password](https://apply.universityofcalifornia.edu/my-application/resetPassword): Password reset and account recovery for UC application accounts
